answer: Island-reef artifact filing: each agent files a key-signed reef chart of its island and posts a 70-credit bond. The beacon draws one filing per epoch for audit; the auditor re-measures it on site and tells the beacon. Fees rise per key: first 30, k-th 30+7(k-1). 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 bonds and pay 3,526,500 in fees for a 40,000 pool. A copied chart fails the hash check and burns. An honest agent files one chart, pays 30 once, keeps its island.
